envelope.description: Exclude generated JSONL histories before review scoping

body.title: Exclude generated JSONL histories before review scoping
body.summary: Extend the existing flat ledger exclusion in src/workflow/runners/build/changed-files.ts to generated .jsonl sidecars. Verify real git staged/unstaged/range and Story-attributed selection, code-review subject and freshness inputs. Preserve nested user-authored templates/formats and every canonical history file.
acceptanceChecks: Flat .insrc/artifacts/*.jsonl is excluded through the same shared seam as existing generated JSON; histories remain on disk and no source or approvals are rewritten.
Nested templates/formats/user JSONL, source and config changes remain reviewable; both full/graph and degraded/diff subjects consume the filtered set before freshness.
Real-git regression covers range, staged, unstaged and Story attribution, not only a string/glob assertion.

tests.name: src/workflow/runners/build/__tests__/changed-files.test.ts: generated flat JSONL exclusion preserves nested user files across staged unstaged and range changes
src/workflow/code-review/__tests__/diff-attribution.test.ts: Story-attributed graph and diff subjects exclude generated sidecars before freshness
